visual_review.method: six decoded frames spanning 0–7.8 seconds per video, plus full decode; not a claim of real-time playback review
visual_review.decision: not approved for final flagship release
findings: Cars stay readable and road-aligned in sampled frames; independent wheel mesh-contact regression passed on CI.
Mountain: continuous backdrop but terrain remains stylized; shoulders too uniform.
Circuit: coherent reflected light pools and kerbs; pit architecture sparse.
City: readable vehicle and wet-looking surface; facades too repetitive and artificial.
Rally: real movement and gravel contact; distant foliage LOD sparse and silhouettes repetitive.
visual_review.scope: Controlled A/B isolates scanned surfaces only, not an entire legacy-versus-V5 overhaul.
